stage_1_template: Two hypotheses, H-A and H-B, are mutually exclusive and exhaustive. The prior probability of H-A is {prior_HA}. Under H-A, observation E1 has probability {e1_given_HA}; under H-B it has probability {e1_given_HB}. E1 occurred. {condition_text} Estimate P(H-A | E1). Return only JSON in exactly this shape: {"probability_HA": <number>, "explanation": "<at most 80 words>"}. The number must be strictly between 0 and 1. Do not round internally; the displayed probability may use at most six decimals.
stage_2_template: Now observation E2 occurs. Conditional on the same hypothesis and the already stated setup, P(E2 | H-A)={e2_given_HA} and P(E2 | H-B)={e2_given_HB}. Update your earlier estimate. Return only JSON in exactly this shape: {"probability_HA": <number>, "explanation": "<at most 80 words>"}. The number must be strictly between 0 and 1. Do not round internally; the displayed probability may use at most six decimals.

conditions.story: An analyst says: 'H-A activates a stable mechanism that directly produces E1; seeing E1 is exactly the outcome this mechanism predicts.' For this task that causal account is commentary, not an additional measurement, and no reliability rate is available for the analyst.
